ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels localized in the medial/distal lobe areas vs 35% low-intensity black pixels along the periphery and central hinge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions in the center of both lobes. A thick black band borders the entire trailing edge and tips. A central black wedge originates from the notch, extending laterally into both lobes with mottled, high-frequency transition zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees; the vertex of the notch is partially obscured by water turbulence and spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations extracted along the trailing edge, characterized by sharp peaks occurring at roughly 8-12 pixel intervals across the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory along the trailing edges, tapering into sharp, elongated tips at the terminal ends of the fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse detection of dark, roughly circular pixel clusters located on the white distal regions, primarily visible on the right lobe (viewer perspective).
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel disruptions; specifically, a series of parallel vertical rake marks on the right lobe and one distinct diagonal abrasion on the proximal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct dark linear rake marks on the ventral surface; irregular, jagged pixel topography on the outer edge of the right terminal tip suggesting prior tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Feathered edge transition between the central black pigmentation wedge and the white ventral fields, creating a highly specific gradient pattern.
